title: 3 Plumbing Mistakes That Cost Homeowners Hundreds
description: Small everyday habits can lead to unexpected plumbing repairs. One of the most common mistakes is placing drop-in chemical cleaning tablets inside your toilet tank. While they keep the bowl looking fresh, the concentrated caustic chemicals slowly degrade rubber flappers and fill valve seals, causing silent leaks and inflated water bills. Another frequent error is pouring harsh liquid drain openers down clogged pipes, which can weaken PVC glue and corrode metal traps. Lastly, avoid over-tightening plastic under-sink slip nuts with heavy wrenches; hand-tightened plus a quarter turn prevents cracked fittings. Protect your home by choosing safe, mechanical solutions for drain and toilet maintenance.
